g.text: Odd circuits are the left column, even the right — the schedule mirrors the panel itself.
Phase alternates every row, so a two-pole breaker lands on A and B and balances itself.
A copy lives inside the panel door: NEC 408.4(A) wants every circuit distinguishable from the rest.
VA figures are connected load. Demand factors (NEC Article 220) come before sizing the feeder.
Circuits, loads and the panel are fictional.
